title: HABITAT (crew living module)
height: walls 2.8 m, dome rising about 1.8 m
notes: The habitat has no size in the game yet (CONTEXT.md: bunks, galley, mess; nothing places one): 12 x 10 m is the coordinator's pick, the kit's rounded capsule with corners 2.0 m.
Four door spots: 'a module a person lives or works in has one in every wall' (module_doors.gd). Unused ones are sealed hatches and stay clear.
Four berths for a starting crew of two plus arrivals (crew_record.gd STARTING_CREW = player, botanist).
Hygiene cubicle and medbay corner lean clean institutional (place.json shared.theme mix).

concept.read: the concept K03 read element by element in the inventory's concept_elements (data/inventory/habitat.json), each element mapped to its rows or dropped with its reason
